question: What are the gen1 return-shape LDA coefficients that return_shape.py fitted on Elba, saved so the detector can be applied to another tile?

inputs.role: grid geometry: bounds and res_m (5 m, EPSG:26915)
DoD gen2 - gen1, m; only its finiteness enters (flat domain)
vegetation-corrected floodplain DoD, m; defines the NE patch (< -LoD)
per-cell LoD, m; NE patch threshold
gen1 CSF ground returns: cell index, d_mm_corr = height above the slope-normal gen2 surface after the star/lateral corrections, in_grid
gen2 full-density per-cell stats (lidar_fingerprint.py cache); above2m defines OPEN cells
imagery class: p(NE-like) from Landsat-5 2008-10-29, 30 m (map_ne_like.py) -- the TRAINING LABEL

params.name: require_own_return
params.why: return_shape.py's intensity extra drops cells with no return of their own (see fingerprint_common docstring)

params.name: standardise
params.value: "z = (x - mean) / X.std(0) before the LDA; affine-equivalent to return_shape.py's raw fit (checked below)"

masks.name: NE
masks.defn: largest 8-connected patch of dod_floodplain_vegcorr < -lod on the floodplain (EXCLUDED from training)

columns.lo_w: p50 - p10 of the pooled gen1 return heights, mm (lower width)
columns.bowley: (p75 + p25 - 2 p50) / max(p75 - p25, 20 mm) (Bowley skew, dimensionless)
columns.peak: share of pooled returns within +/-50 mm of the mode
columns.tail_L: mean of (h - mode - 100 mm) over returns above mode + 100 mm (e-folding length of the upper tail), mm
columns.tail_mass: share of pooled returns above mode + 100 mm
columns.low_mass: share of pooled returns below mode - 100 mm
columns.pass_: B = NE patch excluded (the saved model); A = NE patch included (reference only)
columns.cells: count of domain cells with >= 30 pooled returns and finite features/label
columns.positives: count of those cells in the 2008 imagery class
columns.auc_cv: ROC AUC of the LDA decision function, 5-fold CV by 500 m block (dimensionless)
columns.auc_resub: ROC AUC of the LDA fitted on all cells, scored on the same cells (resubstitution)
columns.weight: LDA coefficient on the standardised feature (per 1 population-sd of the feature; sign + = towards the class)

notes: gen1 rows in_grid 13928563; within histogram range 13872269
headline: pass B: n 12135, AUC CV 0.708, resub 0.810; pass A: AUC CV 0.818
